dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Highly defined 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity rings are distributed across the dorsal surface. The most prominent structures exhibit a sharp pixel gradient transition from dark exterior pelage to a light-intensity perimeter, particularly evident in the upper-mid region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid low-intensity dark blobs situated between the annuli. High-intensity pixel concentrations are primarily confined to the thin, irregular borders of the ring-like structures, lacking a central internal gradient in the smaller clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the upper-central region form an irregular quadrilateral. A trio of smaller rings in the upper-left lateral area forms a nearly equilateral triangle.
